GitHub Issue: Post Date: 2019-07-01T20:44:37Z Current Date: April 4 2025 Title: Cannot escape out of the search sidebar anymore Description: Issue Type: Bug I want the Escape key to close the sidebar if it's open. Long ago (January 2018?) I added this shortcut key to do this: ``` { "key": "escape", "command": "workbench.action.toggleSidebarVisibility", "when": "sidebarVisible" } ``` It worked great... for a while. As of today, this shortcut no longer works. I believe it's been broken since the Fall 2018 release. I don't care about this specific shortcut... I just want to be able to close the sidebar with the Escape key. How can I do that? UPDATE: The sidebar I'm mostly trying to escape from is the Search sidebar, not the workspace explorer sidebar. This used to work and now it doesn't. UPDATE 2: the problem is that the `"sidebarVisible"` context was renamed to `"sideBarVisible"`. using the new name fixes the problem. but seriously vscode team, why rename something like this?
